datasets.name: AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance (UCI)
datasets.source: UCI ML Repository, documented as synthetic industrial data.
datasets.real_outcomes: No. Documented as synthetic.
datasets.reason: Synthetic milling-machine failures. Machine tool wear is not interchangeable with vehicle components.

datasets.name: Auto repair orders, parts and invoices (relational, v1)
datasets.source: Customer e-mails use the reserved example.org domain and names are generator output; treated as a synthetic relational sample.
datasets.identifiers: Vehicle and order IDs, on a generated sample
datasets.real_outcomes: No. Service completion in a generated sample.
datasets.suitable_for: A schema reference for outcome tables, nothing else.
datasets.reason: 238 orders with reserved example.org emails and generated names. A completed work order does not confirm a component failure.

datasets.name: Automotive fault diagnosis flowcharts (AKTC/oBike et al.)
datasets.source: Compiled diagnostic flowcharts; source attribution in the file name only.
datasets.real_outcomes: Not applicable: diagnostic steps.
datasets.suitable_for: Symptom guidance, shown as unverified reference.
datasets.reason: 99 symptom-to-steps entries including Air Conditioning (8) and Cooling (8). Diagnostic instructions are not fault records. Its source is not verified locally, so results are labelled as such. Coverage of suspension (steering only) and tires (3 entries) is thin.

datasets.name: carOBD Toyota Etios OBD-II telemetry
datasets.source: github.com/eron93br/carOBD
datasets.license: README asks for citation; no formal licence.
datasets.real_outcomes: No fault or repair labels.
datasets.suitable_for: Unsupervised sensor anomaly research (existing experiment, not served).
datasets.reason: Real telemetry from one 2014 Toyota Etios with no outcomes. Unusual sensor readings are not confirmed faults, so it supports none of the four AI tasks in production.

datasets.name: Chinese Vehicle Fleet Fault Association Dataset (CVFFAD)
datasets.source: Its own records carry source='generated'; the README DOI is a placeholder and the referenced licence file is absent. Root copies are byte-identical to the folder copies.
datasets.license: README claims CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; licence file absent.
datasets.identifiers: vehicle_id and dates, on generated records
datasets.real_outcomes: No. Its records carry source='generated'.
datasets.reason: Fault events look like failure history, but they are generated. Its README DOI is a placeholder and its licence file is absent. Using it would present fabricated histories as evidence.

datasets.name: Diesel Vehicle OBD-II PID Dataset (ANCEL ELITE 610)
datasets.source: README documents 8 named vehicles; DTC columns are constant per vehicle, so they identify the vehicle rather than a time-varying fault state.
datasets.license: README claims CC BY 4.0; no separate licence file.
datasets.identifiers: No per-row vehicle column; README lists 8 vehicles
datasets.real_outcomes: Stored fault codes per vehicle, not repairs. Codes are constant per vehicle, so they identify the vehicle rather than a changing fault state.
datasets.reason: A model would learn which vehicle a row came from. Over three quarters of workbook rows are exact duplicates per the earlier inventory.

datasets.name: DTC diagnostic chat examples (train/validation parquet)
datasets.source: No source documentation. Assistant answers are templated and contain truncated, unrelated 'technical context' text, so they are not used as reference answers; only user questions are used.
datasets.real_outcomes: No.
datasets.suitable_for: User questions only, as chat routing test cases.
datasets.reason: Templated instruction-tuning conversations. Answers contain unrelated text and are not used.

datasets.name: Engine condition sensor tables (raw_data/train/test)
datasets.source: No source documentation. raw_data.csv is the exact union of train.csv and test.csv.
datasets.real_outcomes: Unknown: a binary label whose meaning is undocumented.
datasets.reason: No source, licence, units or engine grouping. raw_data.csv is the union of train.csv and test.csv. The existing experiment barely beats its baseline.

datasets.name: EngineFaultDB
datasets.source: Laboratory engine test bench repository.
datasets.real_outcomes: Laboratory fault classes on one engine; numeric class meanings are not documented locally.
datasets.suitable_for: Nothing until run identifiers and class names are obtained.
datasets.reason: Labelled, but any split would mix rows from one run, which leaks, and the classes cannot be named. Not trained.

datasets.name: EV Predictive Maintenance Dataset (15-minute)
datasets.source: No source documentation. Columns are statistically independent of each other and of the labels (|r| < 0.005, lag-1 autocorrelation 0), which indicates independently generated random values.
datasets.identifiers: Timestamps, but columns are statistically independent
datasets.real_outcomes: No. The failure and RUL columns are independent of the signals.
datasets.suitable_for: Nothing beyond the earlier signal audit.
datasets.reason: Named after predictive maintenance and has the right column names, but the earlier audit found no learnable signal (|r| < 0.005 and no autocorrelation), which indicates generated values.

datasets.name: Experimental Energy Characterization (NEDC/WLTP)
datasets.source: No accompanying documentation.
datasets.real_outcomes: No.
datasets.reason: No documented vehicle, units, labels, source or licence, and substantial missing values.

datasets.name: Honda (AHM) motorcycle master parts list, Sep 2025 update 19
datasets.source: Dealer price-list style export; no licence file.
datasets.real_outcomes: No.
datasets.reason: A parts list for one motorcycle brand. It says nothing about condition or failure.

datasets.name: Hyundai component readings (cars_hyundai.csv)
datasets.source: No source documentation. Values are uniformly distributed and uncorrelated with the anomaly label.
datasets.real_outcomes: No. The anomaly flag is uncorrelated with the readings.
datasets.suitable_for: Nothing beyond the earlier signal audit.
datasets.reason: Has brake pad thickness and tire pressure columns, but values are uniform and unrelated to the labels. Naming these components does not give predictive capability.

datasets.name: KIT Automotive OBD-II Dataset (Seat Leon)
datasets.source: doi:10.35097/1130 (KIT); Automotive_Diagnostics-main is a notebook repository bundling the same CSVs.
datasets.real_outcomes: No. Tags describe road and traffic conditions.
datasets.reason: Real, well documented telemetry from one Seat Leon, without any fault or maintenance outcome.

datasets.name: LEVIN open data (documentation only)
datasets.source: Repository without the raw measurement export.
datasets.license: Data CC BY-NC-SA per README; code MIT.
datasets.real_outcomes: Not available.
datasets.reason: Documentation and notebooks only. The measurement export is not present locally.

datasets.name: Diesel engine air-path fault set (main_df_standardized, metadata.json, cycles.json)
datasets.source: metadata.json defines the 18 signals and all 10 fault_type values and cycles.json defines the drive cycles (the signal names and fault values match the parquet columns). Faults are injected, e.g. 'manipulated when MAF fault is active', on a standardized signal set; no source, author or licence is present locally.
datasets.identifiers: drive_cycle only; no vehicle identifier, no timestamp
datasets.real_outcomes: No. Faults are injected (sensor drift, valve clog), not failures that occurred.
datasets.suitable_for: Research classification of injected air-path faults.
datasets.reason: Correction to the earlier audit, which called these labels undocumented: metadata.json and cycles.json at the root of data/raw define every fault class and drive cycle. Labels are usable, but they are injected on data with no named source, all faults share one route, and the inputs are standardized signals an inspection does not record.

datasets.name: NASA Li-ion Battery Aging Datasets
datasets.source: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence.
datasets.license: No licence statement in the local bundle.
datasets.identifiers: Cell ID and cycle number; byte-identical copies must not cross splits
datasets.real_outcomes: Yes, for laboratory 18650 cells: capacity fade to a documented end-of-life threshold.
datasets.reason: Real outcomes, but for small laboratory cells under controlled cycling. It does not represent a 12 V starter battery, an alternator or a vehicle environment, so it gives no predictive capability for Battery and Electrical.

datasets.name: Kawasaki Ninja 400 track telemetry (Circuito de Navarra)
datasets.source: Depositor README (CC BY 4.0, Electronics 15(12):2604).
datasets.identifiers: boot_id; one motorcycle; no calendar dates
datasets.real_outcomes: No.
datasets.reason: Race-track telemetry from one prepared motorcycle. It cannot be used to infer road-fleet maintenance. One raw log (LOG00010.MBL) is empty, as its README documents.

datasets.name: OBDex generic OBD-II DTC and PID reference
datasets.source: github.com/foerbsnavi/obdex
datasets.real_outcomes: Not applicable: reference data.
datasets.suitable_for: Exact fault-code lookup. In production use through the knowledge index.
datasets.reason: CC0 reference of generic fault codes with causes and symptoms. It explains a code; it does not establish that a vehicle has that fault or predict anything. Tire coverage is thin because few codes concern tires.

datasets.name: SCANIA Component X (operational readouts, specifications, time-to-event, labels)
datasets.source: No documentation file is present locally. File names, columns and split sizes match the published SCANIA Component X dataset (Lindgren et al., 2024), but that attribution is inferred, not stated by these files.
datasets.license: Not documented locally; verify against the original publication before redistribution.
datasets.identifiers: vehicle_id and time_step; splits are vehicle-disjoint (verified)
datasets.real_outcomes: Yes: time to repair of one component (train_tte) and class labels by time window. Heavy trucks.
datasets.reason: The only local dataset with real time-to-event repair outcomes per vehicle. 'Component X' is anonymized, so it cannot be claimed for any of the eight categories, and its inputs are anonymized truck counters this fleet does not collect. Provenance is inferred: no documentation or licence is in the folder.

datasets.name: Generated vehicle diagnostic samples (VehicleDiagnosticSample.txt)
datasets.source: Self-described generator output with random measurements; fault codes are not consistent with the stated systems.
datasets.real_outcomes: No.
datasets.reason: Self-described generated diagnostics with random measurements. Indexing it would present fabricated results as reference facts.

datasets.name: Vehicle Maintenance - Service Records (Honda/Toyota, India)
datasets.source: Public Kaggle-style export; no local source or licence file. Records are internally consistent with manufacturer service schedules (e.g. 60,000 km major service).
datasets.license: Not documented locally; verify before redistribution.
datasets.identifiers: slno is a row number, not a vehicle; no dates
datasets.real_outcomes: No. It records service items done at a visit, not failures.
datasets.reason: Recorded workshop data, not synthetic, and the closest thing to maintenance history, but it holds no condition ratings, with no vehicle identity or chronology, and a service visit does not establish a failure. service_need_v1, v2 and v3 were trained on it and all failed their acceptance criteria.
